dialogue.trounoir.aldric.1: Step back three paces. That is the length of my blade.
dialogue.trounoir.aldric.2: I guard a king. What do you guard?
dialogue.trounoir.aldric.3: I saw Cledith fight, once. I have not slept since.
dialogue.trounoir.bragor.1: I do not move. That is my whole art.
dialogue.trounoir.bragor.3: Break your fists if it amuses you.
dialogue.trounoir.chevalier.1: A knight does not chat with a vagrant.
dialogue.trounoir.chevalier.2: Across the sea, our best would be mere recruits.
dialogue.trounoir.chevalier.3: The Greyhaven ship almost never brings anyone back.
dialogue.trounoir.citoyen.1: You come from Nebulosia? Poor thing.
dialogue.trounoir.citoyen.2: The Emperor is over a thousand years old. He will see a thousand more.
dialogue.trounoir.citoyen.3: Do not look up too long. Suke is watching.
dialogue.trounoir.citoyen.4: Three kingdoms, one throne: Corollis, Épinoire, Pétalune.
dialogue.trounoir.cledith.1: You hold your weapon like an apology.
dialogue.trounoir.cledith.2: I have no equal. That is not pride, it is boredom.
dialogue.trounoir.cledith.3: Come back when you can die less quickly.
dialogue.trounoir.comete.2: I carry Father's messages. There is never one for you.
dialogue.trounoir.corvin.1: I saw you coming an hour ago.
dialogue.trounoir.corvin.2: A scout who talks is a poor scout.
dialogue.trounoir.corvin.3: Something is wrong with you. I will find out what.
dialogue.trounoir.garmond.1: The seat was empty. I took it. That is all.
dialogue.trounoir.garmond.2: I am worth as much as the one who died.
dialogue.trounoir.hestia.1: Hit me. Go on. I will feel nothing.
dialogue.trounoir.hestia.2: The body is a spell like any other.
dialogue.trounoir.hestia.3: Aldric talks too much. I hold.
dialogue.trounoir.higgs.1: You weigh nothing. I know: I am the one who weighs.
dialogue.trounoir.higgs.2: I sentenced you to live among them. It was mercy.
dialogue.trounoir.higgs.3: Weaker than a man. And here you stand before me.
dialogue.trounoir.higgs.4: How many times did you die to get here?
dialogue.trounoir.ignarelle.1: Everything burns. One need only ask loudly enough.
dialogue.trounoir.ignarelle.2: You smell of the cold of graves.
dialogue.trounoir.ignarelle.3: Come closer and I will light you up.
dialogue.trounoir.kael.1: The throne was empty. An empty throne is an invitation.
dialogue.trounoir.kael.2: I am not Segaroth. I need not be.
dialogue.trounoir.legionnaire.2: Here, a legionary is worth one of your knights. It is the lowest rank.
dialogue.trounoir.legionnaire.3: We killed a Goddess. Remember that.
dialogue.trounoir.lysmene.1: Cold is honest. It pretends nothing.
dialogue.trounoir.lysmene.2: You have no mana. None. How do you stand?
dialogue.trounoir.mage_royal.1: Magic hardens flesh too. Ask Hestia.
dialogue.trounoir.mage_royal.2: There is an altar to the south. The moon comes down there. Do not go.
dialogue.trounoir.magistere.1: Andromeda died here. Her tomb still has a keeper.
dialogue.trounoir.magistere.2: A God can die. We have demonstrated it.
dialogue.trounoir.mars.1: You bleed like them. It is disgusting.
dialogue.trounoir.mars.3: Father was right to cast you out.
dialogue.trounoir.mourning.nebulosia: Not today. The kingdom is in mourning.
dialogue.trounoir.nebula.1: I watched you being born. You were so small we took you for nothing.
dialogue.trounoir.nebula.2: All that dies in me is reborn. You too, in your way.
dialogue.trounoir.noctalys.2: The Emperor has a shadow. You are speaking to it.
dialogue.trounoir.noctalys.3: I know how many times you breathe a minute.
dialogue.trounoir.oriel.1: The space between us exists only because I allow it.
dialogue.trounoir.oriel.2: You are a point. A very dense point. That is strange.
dialogue.trounoir.oriel.3: Do not step on my figures.
dialogue.trounoir.paysan.1: You look like someone a wolf could kill.
dialogue.trounoir.paysan.2: The harvest will be thin. It always is.
dialogue.trounoir.paysan.3: Do not go up to the moor. Gorgath eats knights there.
dialogue.trounoir.paysan.4: The Supernovas? They say one is worth an army. I have never seen one.
dialogue.trounoir.pretorien.2: The Hypernovas are eight. None has ever lost.
dialogue.trounoir.pulsar.1: One. Two. One. Two. You are off the beat.
dialogue.trounoir.pulsar.2: I announce the Gods. I have never announced you.
dialogue.trounoir.pulsar.3: Listen. That is the rhythm of your end.
dialogue.trounoir.quasar.1: You swallow without shining. What a waste.
dialogue.trounoir.quasar.2: I eat as much as you. But I am seen.
dialogue.trounoir.quasar.3: Give me your hunger. You do nothing with it.
dialogue.trounoir.roi_aurele.2: A king of Nebulosia rules a small kingdom. He knows it.
dialogue.trounoir.roi_aurele.3: The Empire tolerates us. Pray it lasts.
dialogue.trounoir.saturne.1: The sentence was passed. It is eternal.
dialogue.trounoir.saturne.2: You were not condemned for a fault. You were condemned for what you are.
dialogue.trounoir.saturne.3: Justice is not debated. It is endured.
dialogue.trounoir.segaroth.1: I have seen thirty kings of Nebulosia born and buried.
dialogue.trounoir.segaroth.2: The Gods are not immortal. They are merely old. So am I.
dialogue.trounoir.segaroth.3: There is something in you that hungers. I know that hunger.
dialogue.trounoir.segaroth.4: A thousand years. And it is you who comes.
dialogue.trounoir.selene.1: Little brother. You have changed your face again.
dialogue.trounoir.selene.2: I will not tell Father you came.
dialogue.trounoir.selene.3: You remember, do you not? All the times.
dialogue.trounoir.sol.2: I am the firstborn. You are the mistake.
dialogue.trounoir.sol.3: There is no shadow at noon. There is no place for you.
dialogue.trounoir.soldat.2: The castle lies southeast. You will not get in.
dialogue.trounoir.soldat.3: Captain Aldric cuts a boulder like bread. I saw it.
dialogue.trounoir.suke.2: Distance is a courtesy. You just broke it.
dialogue.trounoir.suke.3: Hide under a roof. I am patient.
dialogue.trounoir.tirailleur.1: If you see a glint in the sky, it is almost too late already.
dialogue.trounoir.tirailleur.2: The Needle sees the whole continent.
dialogue.trounoir.trou_blanc.2: What you take, I give back. We could have been a circle.
dialogue.trounoir.trou_blanc.3: I stopped time to watch you leave. Father never knew.
dialogue.trounoir.trou_blanc.4: You have come before. I feel it. How many times?
dialogue.trounoir.valdrek.1: An army is a weapon. I am the hand.
dialogue.trounoir.valdrek.2: We lost ten thousand men to kill Andromeda. It was cheap.
dialogue.trounoir.zephyrine.2: I was behind you before your sentence ended.
feat.trounoir.theomachy: Killed the Father of the Gods

technique.trounoir.crane_fletri.desc: A skull that bursts and withers.
technique.trounoir.crocs.desc: A line of jaws bursts from the ground.
technique.trounoir.detonation.desc: A blast around you that spares you.
technique.trounoir.effondrement.desc: Everything falls toward you. That is what you are.
technique.trounoir.estoc.desc: A lunge through the enemy guard.
technique.trounoir.jet_relativiste.desc: A beam that pierces all it meets.
technique.trounoir.lame_solaire.desc: A wide arc of burning blade.
technique.trounoir.maree_de_sang.desc: Cleaves all around and slakes you.
technique.trounoir.maree_lunaire.desc: The moon hides and heals you.
technique.trounoir.mille_ans.desc: Refuse to die, as he did for a thousand years.
technique.trounoir.mille_lames.desc: Everything within blade's reach is cut.
technique.trounoir.onde_sonique.desc: A scream that goes through everything, armor included.
technique.trounoir.ordre_de_charge.desc: You give yourself the order. You obey.
technique.trounoir.prison_de_glace.desc: Freezes in place everything around you.
technique.trounoir.rafale.desc: A blast of wind that sweeps away.
technique.trounoir.rayon_gardien.desc: A beam that sears one target.
technique.trounoir.rugissement.desc: Pushes back and weakens all around.
technique.trounoir.trainee.desc: Cross the battlefield in one stroke.
technique.trounoir.verdict.desc: The sentence falls on all at once.

trait.trounoir.ambition_de_garmond.desc: He wanted the seat. You took his.
trait.trounoir.art_de_l_epee.desc: A blade is no longer a stick.
trait.trounoir.audace_de_kael.desc: He dared sit on the empty throne.
trait.trounoir.balance_de_saturne.desc: Every blow taken is a blow returned.
trait.trounoir.berceau_de_nebula.desc: Where stars are born, nothing dies quickly.
trait.trounoir.brasier_d_ignarelle.desc: Fire obeys you and no longer touches you.
trait.trounoir.cadence_de_pulsar.desc: The world beats to your measure.
trait.trounoir.chair_rustique.desc: A body that stands up and finally digests.
trait.trounoir.colosse.desc: Big, heavy, hard to bring down.
trait.trounoir.couronne_de_sol.desc: The pride of day, on the head of the weakest.
trait.trounoir.croc_et_griffe.desc: Hands that know how to tear.
trait.trounoir.discipline.desc: Hold your guard. Hold your rank.
trait.trounoir.discipline_imperiale.desc: A thousand years of army in one body.
trait.trounoir.echolocation.desc: Nearby living things stand out from the world.
trait.trounoir.essence_inconnue.desc: A little life stolen from a nameless creature.
trait.trounoir.fletrissure.desc: At level II, your blows wither.
trait.trounoir.force_brute.desc: Strike like those who never doubt.
trait.trounoir.foudre_de_zephyrine.desc: Before they see you, you have already passed.
trait.trounoir.galop.desc: Run long, step over without jumping.
trait.trounoir.gemellite.desc: What one swallowed, the other gave back. You are both.
trait.trounoir.geometrie_d_oriel.desc: Space is a fold to be undone.
trait.trounoir.givre_de_lysmene.desc: Your blows freeze, your spells bite.
trait.trounoir.givre_errant.desc: At level III, your blows slow.
trait.trounoir.immortalite_de_segaroth.d: A thousand years of life, torn from the one mortal who equaled the Gods.
trait.trounoir.labeur_humain.desc: A mortal's hands know work. So do yours, now.
trait.trounoir.maitrise_de_cledith.desc: The power and mastery of the greatest swordsman.
trait.trounoir.masse_de_fer.desc: A golem's weight in every motion.
trait.trounoir.masse_primordiale.desc: He who gave all things their weight. The Father is dead.
trait.trounoir.nage.desc: Water no longer holds you back.
trait.trounoir.oeil_de_suke.desc: See a whole continent. Your arrows fly straight, very far.
trait.trounoir.ombre_de_corvin.desc: Striking from behind becomes an art.
trait.trounoir.ossature_abyssale.desc: The body of the Warden of the deep.
trait.trounoir.regard_ancien.desc: See as the deep sea sees.
trait.trounoir.rouille_de_mars.desc: Your blows rust what they touch and feed you.
trait.trounoir.sang_arcanique.desc: Techniques hit harder and return sooner.
trait.trounoir.sang_de_braise.desc: At level III, fire is no longer your concern.
trait.trounoir.sang_de_dragon.desc: The sky of the End runs in your veins.
trait.trounoir.sang_royal.desc: Aurèle's blood. It does not make you king.
trait.trounoir.sceptre_du_roi_fletri.des: To rule what no longer dies.
trait.trounoir.venin.desc: At level II, your blows poison.
trait.trounoir.voile_de_selene.desc: She alone looked at you without contempt.
trait.trounoir.voracite_de_quasar.desc: He envied your hunger. It is doubled now.
trait.trounoir.yeux_de_nuit.desc: At level II, night no longer exists.
trounoir.book.page1:
You are the Black-Hole.

The weakest of the Gods. Weaker than a man.

Higgs, your father, cast you down here forever.

This notebook is all you know.
trounoir.book.page2:
ABSORB

What you kill with your own hands, you become a little.

Sturdy beasts give back hearts. Quick beasts give back legs.

Killing the same kind again strengthens what it gave you, up to a cap.
trounoir.book.page3:
KEYS

K: what you have absorbed (hover a line for details).

R, V, G, B: your techniques.

J: the Chronicle of your lives.
trounoir.book.page4:
RANK

Your power gives you a rank.

If your blows ring hollow, the foe is beyond you: come back stronger.

What killed you yesterday, you will sweep aside tomorrow.
trounoir.book.page5:
COMBAT

The mighty announce their blows: a shape is drawn on the ground. Leave it.

A farm or a cage will not feed you: only what you fell yourself counts.
trounoir.book.page6:
DYING

You will die. Often.

Each time you will return here, at the same instant. The world will have forgotten everything. You will not.

Your strength is lost. What you learned remains.
trounoir.book.page7:
Mortals speak. You do not understand them yet.

There are people to the south-east.

There is a sea, and something else beyond it.

The rest you will learn by dying.

trounoir.reaction.widow_dead: The hollow weaves no more. The peasants look at you differently.
